allocator.installation: future staged executable uses #[global_allocator] BoundedAllocator::qualification(); original eager probe is unchanged
allocator.map_failure: roll back reservation; return null without allocating diagnostics
allocator.realloc: same-size is identity; otherwise allocate-copy-unmap, charge both full mappings concurrently, preserve old allocation on allocation failure
allocator.release: only successful munmap removes charged extent; no malloc cache, free list or uncharged registry
allocator.snapshot: atomic counters are not a concurrent coherent RSS observation
allocator.unmap_failure: retain charge and map count, poison allocator, reject run; further allocations fail
allocator.zero_size: alloc/alloc_zeroed defensively return null; GlobalAlloc dealloc still requires a valid original nonzero allocation; realloc-to-zero returns null and retains old allocation

lifetime_schedule: Compile public context and serially generate/export one raw key at a time; no prepared 33-key bundle. Sparse and dense key identities remain unchanged.
Affine and ModUp: specialized public key owners only for current operation. End all views, drop owners and require unpoisoned allocator before subsequent stage.

C2S: keep at most seven same-role automorphism owners; prepare three baby keys, end map borrows, refill giant keys. Drop raw import and preparation scratch before reserving matrix-aware evaluation scratch.
Before next factor, finish all baby-cache borrows and drop its old cache. Allocate the new correct-width/cache-index owner; no metadata forgery or cross-role cast.

After C2S/split, drop all automorphism owners and DFT scratch. Load one specialized tensor owner; process real and imaginary EvalMod serially. Drop private temporaries and tensor owner before S2C keys.
S2C: same public split phases and seven-key maximum. Before second refresh all old phase owners have been dropped/unmapped; load the same immutable key material.

Keep five 28-limb outer ciphertext owners and one entry-width copy charged. Input is immutable through each refresh; checkpoint/digest validation precedes reuse. Copy/scale/slot metadata must follow original wrappers. Exact adapter type/liveness validation remains pending.
Reject any allocator poison/denial, unqualified key/entry/layout, nonfinite/error-threshold failure, third refresh, swap growth, resource or deadline breach. No fallback primitive or client refresh.
